name: United Kingdom
h1: International Cargo Shipping to United Kingdom from Pakistan
introduction: Direct air cargo allocations and ocean container linehauls connecting export terminals in Pakistan with London Heathrow (LHR), Manchester (MAN), and major UK seaports.
shippingOverview: Cargo services to the United Kingdom support commercial exporters, personal baggage shippers, and household goods relocation. Transit options include express air freight and ocean container dispatches.
customsGuidance: All UK imports require detailed packing lists, commercial invoices with HS codes, and EORI number for commercial consignments. Duty and VAT depend on commodity code classifications.

faqs.question: What is the typical air freight transit time from Pakistan to London Heathrow?
faqs.answer: Air freight transit from Lahore, Karachi, or Islamabad to London Heathrow generally takes 3 to 5 business days.

faqs.question: Are personal luggage and excess baggage allowed to the UK?
faqs.answer: Yes, personal effects and student baggage can be shipped under simplified customs documentation.

seo.metaTitle: Cargo to UK from Pakistan | Air Freight & Sea Shipping to London
seo.metaDescription: International cargo shipping services from Pakistan to the United Kingdom. Express air cargo to London Heathrow and sea shipping to Felixstowe & Southampton.

name: United Arab Emirates
h1: International Cargo Shipping to United Arab Emirates from Pakistan
introduction: Daily air freight services and direct gulf ocean container shipping connecting Pakistan export hubs with Dubai (DXB/DWC), Abu Dhabi (AUH), and Jebel Ali Port.
shippingOverview: Frequent air flights and short ocean transit routes make UAE one of the fastest international shipping corridors from Pakistan for trade samples, commercial cargo, and personal items.
customsGuidance: Commercial trade to UAE requires valid commercial invoices, certificate of origin, and UAE customs registration. Personal goods are processed at destination airport terminals.

faqs.question: How fast is air cargo delivery from Pakistan to Dubai?
faqs.answer: Daily flights provide 1 to 3 day transit for express air freight consignments between Pakistan airports and Dubai.

seo.metaTitle: Cargo to UAE & Dubai from Pakistan | Air & Sea Shipping

name: Saudi Arabia

customsGuidance: Saudi customs require SABER platform compliance for commercial products, detailed itemized packing lists, and SASO documentation where applicable.

faqs.question: Can I ship cargo to Riyadh and Jeddah?

name: Canada
